title: capacity_estimate.v1
description: The numbers a service is designed against, written before it is built (00_UniversalStandards/16_Service_Design_Record.md §4; the math is docs/PHYSICS_OF_FLOW.md). Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the design record's relationship rules: in_flight_at_peak must cover Little's Law (peak arrival rate x P99 latency), and the record's declared concurrency must hold that in-flight load.

arrival_rate_per_second.description: Requests or messages per second. Peak is the provisioned peak, not the mean times a guess.

p99_latency_ms.description: The P99 residence time W the design targets.

in_flight_at_peak.description: L = peak arrival rate x P99 latency, rounded up.

remote_calls_per_request.description: Network round trips one request makes, counting each call inside a loop.

fan_out_width.description: The most dependencies one request calls in parallel.

read_write_ratio.description: Reads per write; 0 for a write-only service.

lever.description: The fix the design relies on: fewer or closer round trips for latency; batching, compression or wider pipes for bandwidth.

serial_point.description: The part every request passes through one at a time (a single leader, a global lock, a hot row), or 'none' with the reason.
